focus: Anuppur Genie Z-135 Starter Motor Burnout & Mobile Network Blackout, Cross-Rent 1932 Electrical Connector Fault, Mundra 5390 (SN: 3902) Starting Glitch & Telescopic Line Leakage, Mundra 6228/4047 Hydraulic Hose Rupture, Mundra Genie 4047 (SN: 964) Severe Drive Sluggishness & Battery Collapse, Restored Mundra Units (JLG 860SJ, 4550 Tyres & ST Basket Function), Noida Genie 1930 (SN: 21734) Chronic Hydraulic Tank Oil Leakage & Client Escalation, Sanand Micron Operator Gate Pass Migration & Strict Ban on Night Maintenance, MHE Multi-City Servicing (Ahmedabad Order Picker Commissioned, Dahej Radiator Hose Restored, Pune RT Drive Wheel, Samsung RT & JK Paper 5-Ton Forklift), Bhiwadi Card 302 & AI Camera 507 Rectification, and Fleet-Wide Vishwakarma Puja Preparations

breakdowns.site: Anuppur Site (MP) — Genie Z-135 Burnt Starter Motor & Remote Telecommunications Blackout
breakdowns.issue: The Genie Z-135 articulated boom lift at the Anuppur project experienced a complete starting failure due to an electrically burnt starter motor ('Z-135 starter jal gaya'). Umesh Kumar reported that this failure followed the critical engine oil depletion warning flagged on September 15, confirming the starter motor sustained severe electrical thermal stress during prolonged dry cranking attempts. Furthermore, extreme cellular network degradation across the Anuppur project site made night-time phone communications inaudible when the operator attempted to report the breakdown, delaying real-time technical diagnosis.
breakdowns.action: Umesh Kumar confirmed the burnt starter upon stepping outside the plant to obtain cellular reception. Jitendra Budhauliya instructed immediate dispatch of a replacement starter motor or sourcing an emergency local heavy-duty rewinding vendor. Site communication protocols were updated to maintain telecommunications redundancy in remote cellular dead zones.
breakdowns.status: Starter Motor Burnt; Cranking Prohibited; Replacement Starter Procurement & Express Dispatch Lined Up; Remote Telecommunications Escalation Logged

breakdowns.site: Cross-Rent Fleet (Umesh Site) — Scissor Lift 1932 Electrical Connector Fault & Pre-Replacement Certification
breakdowns.issue: Scissor lift 1932 (operated under a cross-hire agreement) suffered an operational stoppage caused by an intermittent electrical wiring harness connector. Umesh Kumar had previously posted the issue in the operational group, but followup was delayed due to network connectivity issues. Since the machine belongs to an external cross-hire partner, procuring redundant OEM connectors or wiring looms would incur unnecessary rental expenses if terminal re-crimping or contact cleaning can resolve the fault.
breakdowns.action: Jitendra Budhauliya instructed Umesh to deploy a qualified field mechanic to physically inspect, clean, and recrimp the connector pins. If the connector is physically broken beyond repair, the technician must officially certify the requirement before purchasing a replacement component.
breakdowns.status: Mechanic Deployment Scheduled for Connector Certification; Cross-Rent Repair Protocol Enforced to Avoid Unnecessary Parts Billing

breakdowns.site: Mundra Fleet — Machine 5390 (SN: 3902) Starting Circuit Failure & 510 Telescopic Assembly Leakage
breakdowns.issue: Unit 5390 (Serial Number: 3902) stationed at the Mundra facility has been grounded since yesterday by a dual mechanical/electrical failure: an intermittent starting circuit failure, compounded by active hydraulic oil leakage originating from the 510 telescopic cylinder seal assembly.
breakdowns.action: Umesh Kumar confirmed the exact machine serial number (3902) to central stores. On-site technical crew instructed to test starting interlocks and inspect the telescopic boom cylinder seal to measure the leakage rate, while Delhi stores cross-references seal kit availability.
breakdowns.status: Serial Number 3902 Verified; Starting Interlocks & Telescopic Seal Leakage Under Mechanical Inspection; Spares Kit Staged

breakdowns.site: Mundra Fleet — Boom Lift 6228 / 4047 High-Pressure Hydraulic Hose Rupture & Local Crimping Overhaul
breakdowns.issue: Boom lift unit 6228 / 4047 suffered a severe hydraulic hose rupture yesterday ('pipe fat gaya kal'), completely disabling boom elevation under urgent client work commitments.
breakdowns.action: On-site mechanics immediately removed the ruptured high-pressure hose and transported the damaged assembly to a local hydraulic workshop for custom hose fabrication and precision crimping. Once re-fitted and topped up with hydraulic oil, the unit will undergo operational pressure testing.
breakdowns.status: Ruptured Hose Removed; Local Fabrication & Crimping Underway; Machine Re-commissioning Scheduled Upon Hose Fitment

breakdowns.site: Mundra Fleet — Genie 4047 Scissor Lift (SN: 964) Crawling Marching Speed & Complete Battery Bank Breakdown
breakdowns.issue: Genie 4047 scissor lift (Serial Number: 964) suffered severe drive degradation, moving at an excruciatingly slow, ant-like crawl speed ('cheenti ki tarah bohot slow chal rahi hai'). Sitaram had initially flagged the crawling speed defect. Today, the unit experienced a total breakdown after its traction battery pack collapsed completely under load.
breakdowns.action: A replacement battery pack has safely arrived at the site. Technicians are completing urgent hydraulic hose repairs on unit 6228 first, after which they will immediately install the new battery pack, inspect terminal torque, and calibrate the proportional drive controller.
breakdowns.status: Complete Battery Failure Breakdown; Replacement Battery Pack Received On-Site; Battery Retrofit Scheduled Following Hydraulic Hose Completion

breakdowns.site: Mundra Fleet — JLG 860SJ Engine, 4550 Tyre Replacement, and ST Basket Function Operational Sign-Off
breakdowns.issue: Multiple standing equipment issues at Mundra were tracked for operational clearance: (1) JLG 860SJ had been down with operational glitches; (2) Unit 4550 was grounded due to damaged industrial solid tyres; (3) Unit ST suffered platform basket control and leveling malfunction.
breakdowns.action: Umesh Kumar and Jitendra Budhauliya confirmed that all three units have been fully resolved and tested: JLG 860SJ is restored and operational, solid tyres on unit 4550 were successfully replaced and mounted, and the basket leveling and control circuit on unit ST was repaired and certified for work.
breakdowns.status: 3 Units Restored to Full Production; JLG 860SJ, 4550 Tyres, and ST Basket Controls Operational and Handed Over to Site Operations

breakdowns.site: Noida Site — Genie 1930 (SN: 21734) Hydraulic Reservoir Oil Leak & Urgent Leakage Elimination
breakdowns.issue: Genie 1930 scissor lift (Serial Number: 21734) at the Noida facility has an active hydraulic tank oil leak that was initially reported 10-15 days ago. Hydraulic fluid is dripping onto the client's shop floor, triggering furious complaints from plant management ('oil girta hai toh client chillata hai'). Although the machine remains operational, continuous fluid loss risks environmental safety violations and hydraulic pump cavitation.
breakdowns.action: Jitendra Budhauliya intervened decisively, assigning technician Rohit to attend the Noida machine today. Rohit must immediately inspect the tank drain valve, weld seam, and return line grommet, drain and reseal the reservoir, and clean all contaminated surfaces to satisfy client safety audits.
breakdowns.status: High Client Environmental Escalation; Immediate Intervention Assigned to Rohit; Tank Sealing & Site Clean-Up Mandated Today

breakdowns.site: Sanand Micron Semiconductor Facility — Total Workforce Gate Pass Migration & Strict Night Maintenance Prohibition
breakdowns.issue: Micron plant security expelled an external contractor agency ('Micron wale ne doctor/agency ko bahar kar diya'), causing an administrative overhaul where all Reach operator security gate passes must be re-registered and shifted to the Micron plant system. Pandit Dheeraj Dubey and Khemchand are fully occupied at the security office processing Aadhaar verifications and security badges. Meanwhile, Deepak is the lone field technician managing multiple complex sites (serviced CG Semi tyres yesterday, checked 1932 at Micron at 6 PM, and is replacing cylinder seals on 5390 today). A scissor lift with collapsed batteries received its new battery pack, but Deepak cannot install it due to lack of time. When Jitendra suggested performing the battery swap during the night shift with overtime, Dheeraj pointed out that Micron plant safety regulations strictly prohibit all after-hours night maintenance ('Micron ke andar night mein maintenance kaam karna allow nahi hai!').
breakdowns.action: Dheeraj Dubey scheduled the battery installation for September 18 (since September 17 is Vishwakarma Puja holiday/stand-down). Deepak instructed to complete the 5390 seal replacement during daylight hours; gate pass documentation prioritized to ensure unbroken fleet operation.
breakdowns.status: Operator Gate Pass Migration Active; Strict Micron Night-Shift Maintenance Prohibition Enforced; Battery Bank Fitment Set for Sept 18

breakdowns.site: Material Handling (MHE) Fleet — Multi-Site Restoration, JK Paper 5-Ton Backlog, Pune RT Drive Wheel, and Bhiwadi Electronic Card 302
breakdowns.issue: Sushil Mishra presented a comprehensive MHE fleet status review: (1) Ahmedabad: Order picker machine was successfully repaired, tested, and returned to client operations; (2) JK Paper Site: The heavy-duty 5-ton forklift remains grounded with unresolved hydraulic and transmission issues; (3) Pune Project: Reach Truck (RT) drive wheel replacement is pending sourcing/fitment, while all other mechanical servicing is completed; (4) Samsung Project: RT maintenance is scheduled for execution today; (5) Dahej Project: Radiator water hose replacement on the forklift was successfully completed, restoring engine cooling; (6) Bhiwadi Project (Unit 507): Artificial Intelligence (AI) safety camera system is down, preventing automated pedestrian detection; (7) Bhiwadi Project (Unit 302 at Devli/Warehouse): Electronic logic control card has been defective for over 2 months; past vendor repair attempts failed to restore circuit functionality.
breakdowns.action: Sushil Mishra instructed to supervise Samsung RT repairs today; coordinate shipment of replacement drive wheel to Pune; expedite replacement electronic control card and AI camera for the two Bhiwadi machines; and schedule technician intervention for the JK Paper 5-ton forklift.
breakdowns.status: Ahmedabad & Dahej Fully Operational; Pune RT Drive Wheel & Samsung RT Under Execution; JK Paper 5-Ton Backlog Active; Bhiwadi Card 302 & AI Camera 507 Requisitions Sourced

breakdowns.site: Corporate Fleet Administration — Vishwakarma Puja Stand-Down (Sept 17), Overtime Regularization, & Manpower Expansion
breakdowns.issue: Operations team reviewed site schedules ahead of the annual Vishwakarma Puja on September 17. Jitendra Budhauliya instructed all regional workshops and field sites to report early tomorrow morning to conduct comprehensive equipment cleaning, safety staging, and workshop maintenance rituals. Sushil Mishra highlighted extensive overtime logged after midnight (returned home at 12:30 AM), and Umesh confirmed overtime for Korba operations. Furthermore, field technician shortages across Gujarat and northern sites are straining existing personnel like Deepak.
breakdowns.action: Anil Kumar approved overtime regularization for Sushil Mishra and Korba crews. Jitendra Budhauliya announced technical recruitment: Vikas and Shivam have officially joined Reach fleet maintenance, and 5 additional technicians/assistants are being mobilized immediately to support regional operations.
breakdowns.status: Vishwakarma Puja Mobilization Ordered for Sept 17; Overtime Approved; 5 New Technical Crew Recruited to Reinforce Field Maintenance

directives.title: Strict Compliance with Client Plant Night-Shift Maintenance Prohibitions
points: Plant Safety Primacy: Under no circumstances should field technicians attempt or promise after-hours night maintenance at industrial facilities (such as Micron Semiconductor) where client safety bylaws strictly prohibit night work without dedicated safety officers.
Resource Staging: Shift-restricted maintenance, such as battery replacements or major seal overhauls, must be scheduled during daylight hours with advance plant safety work permits.

directives.title: Zero Tolerance for Chronic Hydraulic Oil Leakages on Client Shop Floors
points: Immediate Containment: Hydraulic reservoir and hose leaks (e.g. Noida Genie 1930) must be treated with emergency priority. Leaving a machine leaking oil on client premises for 10-15 days severely compromises Reach's environmental credibility.
Mandated 24-Hour Rectification: Any unit leaking hydraulic fluid must be grounded or repaired within 24 hours, utilizing spill containment trays during transit and maintenance.

directives.title: Cross-Rent Equipment Repair & Parts Authorization Protocol
points: Technical Certification Prior to Procurement: For machines hired under cross-rental agreements (e.g. Scissor 1932), technicians must physically inspect and attempt terminal/pin reconditioning before management authorizes purchasing replacement OEM harnesses or parts.
Cost Segregation: Prevent cross-hire owners from billing unverified repair charges to Reach by maintaining signed inspection reports and photographic evidence of pre-existing wear.

directives.title: Mandatory Vishwakarma Puja Equipment Maintenance & Safety Stand-Down
points: Annual Workshop Protocols: On the eve of Vishwakarma Puja (September 17), all site operators and mechanics must report early to thoroughly clean, degrease, inspect, and safely stage all aerial work platforms and material handling equipment.
Zero Reckless Operation: Operations and non-critical maintenance will pause on September 17 for the festival; emergency breakdown coverage must be assigned in advance.

directives.title: Field Technical Reinforcement & Overtime Regularization
points: Relieving Single-Technician Bottlenecks: Solitary technicians struggling under multi-site backlogs (such as Deepak at Sanand/Micron) must be reinforced immediately by deploying newly inducted personnel (Vikas, Shivam, and 5 upcoming technicians).
Fair Overtime Accounting: Technical staff executing emergency night breakdown restorations must have overtime hours logged, verified, and approved without administrative friction.
